description_en: Deletes a batch of key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace
description_zh: 根据指定的键名列表来批量删除指定KV存储空间的键值对
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn batch-delete-dcdn-kv --namespace test_namespace --keys test_key1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteDcdnKv

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace. You specify this name when you call [](t2457197.xdita#)
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: A list of keys to delete. You can delete a maximum of 10,000 keys
parameters.help_zh: 要批量删除的键名称列表， 最多删除10000个键
parameters.name: keys
